plain:
In one line: in your chart, 'you' (Ding Fire, like the flame of a lamp) and 'wealth' are both strong, so the chart is fairly balanced.

Why: you were born in early summer, when Fire is at its strongest, so you are not weak; at the same time the chart has two Metal characters (Metal stands for wealth here), and they have roots. The Qiong Tong Bao Jian 穷通宝鉴 says Ding Fire in this season most needs Wood to feed the flame and Metal to split the Wood. Your chart has both, which suits it.

These years: in the Luck Pillar of 2019–2029, Wood gets support in the branches, which helps you; steady progress suits it. 2026 carries a sense of 'peers competing for wealth', so be careful with spending and partnerships.

These are tendencies in a traditional system, not fate.
basis: Climate adjustment follows the Qiong Tong Bao Jian 穷通宝鉴 entry for Ding Fire in the fourth month (original text checked); strength follows the Ziping method: Month Command, roots and revealed stems. What follows is interpretation, not computed by the script; other schools may read it differently.
summary: Ding Fire born in the Si month with Bing Fire ruling; the Year branch Wu is Ding's Prosperity, so the Day Master is in season and rooted, not weak. Geng and Xin are revealed in the year and month, the Day Master sits on You Metal, and Chen and You combine: wealth is equally strong, roughly a balance of self and wealth. The Qiong Tong Bao Jian says of Ding Fire in the fourth month 「取甲引丁，必用庚噼甲」 ('take Jia to kindle Ding; Geng must split the Jia'; our translation) and warns against a revealed Gui Water. Here Jia in the hour and Geng in the year are both revealed, and Gui is only hidden as the residual qi of Chen, which agrees with the text. Taken together, Jia Wood can be the Useful God with Geng Metal assisting; strong Water, which hurts Ding and soaks Jia, is unfavourable.

pillars.年: Gengwu: Geng Metal, Direct Wealth, is revealed; Wu is Ding Fire's Prosperity. Wealth and peers appear together in the ancestral pillar.
pillars.月: Xinsi: the Month Command Si is the Peak stage for Ding Fire, with Bing Fire ruling; Xin Metal, Indirect Wealth, is revealed, rooted in the Geng hidden in Si.
pillars.日: Dingyou: the Day Master sits on You Metal, Indirect Wealth, which is also Ding Fire's Birth stage and a Nobleman star (by table). You combines with the Hour branch Chen (Six Harmonies).
pillars.时: Jiachen: Jia Wood, Direct Resource, is revealed, the very element the Qiong Tong Bao Jian values for this month; but its only root is the Yi Wood middle qi in Chen, so Jia itself is not strong.

dayun.戊寅: Wu Earth, Hurting Officer, sits on top; Yin Wood is a root for Jia, so the Resource star gains ground and the Useful God has strength. Yin punishes and harms the Month branch Si, unsettling the Month Command: steady rather than hasty.
dayun.丁丑: Ding Fire, Friend, supports the Day Master; Chou completes a Three Harmony Metal set with Si and You, so wealth gathers force. Both self and wealth are strong; the key is choosing well.

years.2026: Bingwu year: Bing Fire, Rob Wealth, combines with the Month stem Xin, and Wu meets the Year branch Wu in self-punishment. A picture of peers competing for wealth: hold steady with money rather than take risks. Only a tendency, no need to worry.

advice: Jia Wood as the Useful God: Wood belongs to the east and the colour green (San Ming Tong Hui 三命通会, Wu Xing Da Yi 五行大义). A desk or bed head facing east is an option; this is traditional imagery, not a requirement
Your Kua is Gen, West Group. The Eight Mansions and the favourable elements are two separate methods; when they conflict, put real living conditions first
Luck Pillars and years only show tendencies; base career and money decisions on your actual situation
